AbsoluteDeadline.description: A wall-time instant by which something must happen, in any domain (TM-15, Vision §19).

ArtifactMark.description: One `mark_artifact` reaction recorded against an artifact (RS-30).

ArtifactRef.description:
Large data is always by reference: a locator, a content hash and a size, never
the bytes (RS-44, Vision §50, §51).

continuity.description:
The continuity metadata of SC-30, in SampleClock order. There is more than
one whenever the capture spans a rate change (TM-13c) or a channel-count
change (SC-30a): each ends one map and starts the next (RS-40).

id.description: The artifact's name inside its Run (SB-17).

kind.description: Its kind; a Sink Module's namespace (MA-25).

partial.description: True when it was still open at cleanup, or the Run aborted (RS-26, RS-44).

ChannelGap.description: A channel that lost validity while the stream continued (SC-31d).

local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

node.description: Owning node; `0`, the local node, throughout v4.0 (X7).

ContentHash.description:
`sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`, matching `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`. The algorithm is
named in the value so a later algorithm is an additive change (OV-14, SB-1).

ContinuityMap.description:
What a stream carried, per SampleClock. There is one map per SampleClock: a
block in another domain ends the map, and the Sink starts a new builder (SC-30).

channels.description: The channel count, constant for the map (SC-30a).

end.description: Just past the last sample the map accounts for (SC-30).

first.description: First sample the map accounts for: a first block's leading gap included (SC-30).

valid.description: Per channel, the runs of valid samples (SC-14, SC-30).

Event.description:
The control-path form of an event: a source, a `TimePoint` in a named domain, a
severity, a kind and a schema-versioned payload (Vision §29).

Rule: RS-31.

payload.description: The body; its schema belongs to the kind's owner (RS-31).

EventKind.description:
What kind of event this is, matching `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)+$`:
every kind is namespaced. The Kernel owns the five of RS-28, under `ezsdr.`, and
every other kind belongs to the Vocabulary or Module that emits it.

Rule: SB-1, RS-27.

Gap.description: An interval of missing samples in the stream (SC-30, Vision §28).

link_dropped.description:
How many blocks the link discarded inside the same interval. A block count,
not a sample count: the samples the link lost are `len − lost`, and are
unrecoverable when `lost` is absent. That is a real limit of what a dropped
header can tell us, not an omission (SC-20b, SC-31).

lost.description: What the stream reported losing, when known (SC-13).

GapCause.description:
What the **stream** lost. A closed, derived set (SC-31, decision S16).

What the **link** lost is the separate `link_dropped` count, not a cause, so a
device overflow inside an interval that also lost a block to the link is still
reported as `OverflowRestart` with its sample count, beside a link-drop count of
one. Collapsing the two into a single cause loses the device's own diagnosis.

oneOf.description: `GAP_BEFORE` alone (SC-31).
`RESTARTED`: a stream restart, as a UHD overflow produces (SC-31, OV-23a).
`SEQ_DISCONTINUITY`: transport sequence loss (SC-31).
`ALIGNMENT`: samples the device discarded to keep its channels aligned (SC-31).
A jump with no gap flag on a lossy path (SC-31).

`GAP_BEFORE` with `lost` less than the jump on a lossy path and no carry to
explain the difference (SC-31).

stream_lost.description: What the stream itself reported losing.

oneOf.description: `GAP_BEFORE` with `lost` absent (SC-31).

Ident.description:
A name inside one document, matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`.

Names are compared as bytes; there is no case folding and no Unicode
normalisation, so the canonical form of OV-15 stays byte-comparable.

Rule: SB-1.

Key.description:
A `<vocabulary prefix><path>` or `ext.<module-id>.<path>` key: a Vocabulary key
matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$` and an Extension key
`^ext(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+){2,}$`; a key beginning `ext.` is read as an Extension key only.

The Kernel checks the prefix and the value's shape against the `KeyDecl` and
never interprets the meaning (audit Finding 7).

Rule: SB-1, SB-2, MA-34.

LatePolicy.description: What to do about a burst whose lead is short (SC-27, Vision §22).

oneOf.description:
Legal only for a burst whose target is statically known; `validate()`
rejects it on a runtime-decided burst (SC-27).
Transmit as soon as possible and flag it (SC-27).
Drop the burst and flag it (SC-27).

Namespace.description:
A dotted sequence of `Ident`s owned by a Vocabulary or a Module,
matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$`.

Rule: SB-1.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `0` (the local node) is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-38.

ResourceId.description:
Names a resource, or a sub-resource, inside the composite tree a Provider declares.

The path is a non-empty sequence of segments matching
`^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+){0,15}$`, at most 256 bytes; `dev0/rx/0` names
channel 0 of the receive sub-tree of `dev0`. Vision §49 asks only for the node qualification; the
path replaces §49's flat `local` because a channel or a timekeeper must be
addressable (`00-overview.md` "Where these specs depart from the Vision").

Rule: SB-1, SB-3, SB-33, SB-34 (`03-spec-and-binding.md`), X7.

node.description: Owning node; `0`, the local node, throughout v4.0 (X7).

path.description: Slash-joined path through the composite resource tree (SB-34).

Segment.description: A contiguous run of valid samples on one channel (SC-30).

Severity.description: How bad an event is; RS-29 derives a default reaction from it (Vision §29).

oneOf.description: Diagnostic detail.
Normal progress.
Something is off but the Run continues.
Something failed.
The Run cannot continue.

StopCause.description: Why a Run stopped (RS-3, RS-23, RS-26).

oneOf.description: The client asked (RS-3).
An `Attached` Lease's client went away (RS-23).
A `Detached` Lease's TTL ran out (RS-23).
The Policy table reacted to an event (RS-26).
Something aborted the Run (RS-9).

TimePoint.description:
An instant: integer ticks in a named clock domain. Never floating-point seconds.

There is deliberately no `PartialOrd`: two points of different domains cannot be
compared at all, and `a < b` silently answering `false` is the bug class this
model exists to prevent (decision T3).

Rule: TM-1, TM-6.

ticks.description: Tick count relative to the domain's origin; a sample index in a SampleClock (TM-10).

UpdateClass.description:
How a parameter may be changed while a Run is live (Vision §27).

Rule: MA-24, RS-52.

oneOf.description:
The target stops the affected function, applies the value and, if the function was
running, starts it again; a stream so restarted continues on a new SampleClock (UC-3,
TM-13c).

Applied from the first block or sample boundary at or after the effective
instant; no block mixes the old and new value (UC-4).

Applied to every sample processed after the Action arrives, with no torn state
(UC-5).

Applied by the device at exactly the effective instant, which must respect the
device's command lead (UC-6).

anyOf.description: A signed 64-bit integer, written as an exact decimal by the canonicaliser (OV-15).

A finite float; a non-finite one is refused rather than written as `null`,
because a `Value` reaches the sealed Manifest through `prepare.effective`,
the coercion records and the action log (OV-15, X9).
A list of scalars; nesting deeper is refused (SB-4).
A map of scalars; nesting deeper is refused (SB-4).

Value.description:
A scalar, or a list or map of scalars nested at most one level.

A Spec is data, not a document tree: one level is what a structured parameter
such as a capture request needs, and more invites the schema-inside-a-schema
that Vision §9 rejects.

Rule: SB-4.

description:
The closed Kernel Action set: what a Reactor emits into the real-time path.
Adding a member is a Kernel major.

Every timed Action names its instant with an `AbsoluteDeadline`, which Vision
§19 defines for exactly this and which TM-15 made a distinct type so that
envelope checks have one thing to compare.

Rule: RS-48, RS-49.

oneOf.description:
One transmit burst. Carries no channel list: mapping a burst's channels onto
a stream's channels is the Radio Model's, and deciding it here would put a
radio field in a frozen Kernel document. It travels in `metadata` until
Phase 2 settles it (RS-49).

at.description: The instant, in the transmit stream's SampleClock (RS-51, SC-23a).

late_policy.description: What to do if the lead is short (SC-27).

metadata.description: Namespaced content the Kernel does not interpret (RS-49).

requested_at.description: What was asked for, when SC-23a advanced it onto the sample grid (RS-51).

waveform.description: The samples, by reference; never the bytes (RS-44).

oneOf.description: Wake at an instant (RS-49).

token.description: The caller's token, returned with the wake-up (RS-49).

oneOf.description: Change a declared parameter under its declared update class (RS-52, Vision §27).

at.description:
The instant at or after which the update takes effect under its class.
Absent means the first instant the class permits, which is what a bare
`sdr.rx.gain = 20` asks for (Vision §3). Optional for every class,
including `hardware_timed`: a class cannot make the field mandatory,
because the `set_parameter` Session action carries no time to put in it
(RS-49, RS-19, RS-14).

class.description:
The parameter's declared update class; an undeclared one was rejected at
admission and never arrives (RS-52, RS-17).

oneOf.description: A Vocabulary-defined peripheral operation (RS-49).

verb.description: The verb, defined by its Vocabulary (RS-13a).

oneOf.description: Produce an event (RS-31).

With a target it stops that resource; without one it stops the Run. Vision
§3 uses the word for both, so the ambiguity is resolved in the type (RS-50).

target.description: The resource, or the Run when absent (RS-50).

oneOf.description: End the Run immediately (RS-49).

title: Action
